# Performance ratings stay out of the forecast

- 2026-03-10: Performance ratings are not a forecast feature or a source: rater bias, the curvilinear relation between performance and turnover, and the risk of steering decisions about individuals (ADR 0015). Recorded for the synthetic company.

decisions/DEC-2026-06-02-01.md.text:
---
aliases: [team-level values, team forecasts, manager scorecards]
id: DEC-2026-06-02-01
links: []
type: decision
---
# Team-level values are for People Analysts only

- 2026-06-02: Team-level forecasts are shown to People Analysts only, sorted by name, never ranked or colored by observed over expected, and labeled as not an evaluation of the team's manager. People Partners see groups and organizations (synthetic record).

id: DEC-2026-09-20-01
links: [timeline/daily/2026-09-20]

# Fixed-term employees leave the voluntary departures population

- 2026-09-20: People Analytics decided that voluntary_departures@2 excludes fixed-term employees, whose planned end dates make them a separate planning question. Backtest history is recomputed under @2; voluntary_departures@1 stays computable. Approved by the People Analytics lead (synthetic record).
- 2026-10-01: run R-2026-10-01#1 is the first published forecast under voluntary_departures@2; the change shows as the Definition bar of what changed against R-2026-09-01#1.
